title: Who’s Marketing Better? Good Molecules or BYOMA? 🧖‍♀️
description: Who’s Marketing Better? Good Molecules or BYOMA? 🧖‍♀️
transcript: Who's better marketing, Good Molecules or Byoma? Good Molecules is playing their performance game. They're running 350 active meta ads right now with review ads, ingredient Breakdown, Skincare Quiz funnels, low price hooks, 12 dollar moisturizer, free shipping at 35. Everything is built to get the click and convert the cell with low friction. Their site feels the same way. It's simple P d P with a clear price, proof product claim, and a check out. It is a classic d d C conversion machine. Byoma is playing a completely different game. They're not flooding meta, they are building on culture with bright packaging, barrier repair messaging, TikTok, skincare education, retail shelf dominance in Gen Z, friendly branding. They are not just trying to sell one moisturizer. They are trying to own the skincare conversation and retail is where it gets interesting. Good molecules is strong in places like Ulta and target, but byoma is showing up everywhere. Target, Ulta, Boots, Sephora, Urban Outfitters, Space sell fridges, Amazon. That is not just distribution. That is awareness at scale. And then TikTok. Good Molecules has TikTok shop, which means content can turn into checkouts instantly. Byoma does not seem to be pushing TikTok Shop the same way, which is a very classic mistake. But Byoma already has won massive with TikTok attention through creators already with reviews, skincare education, and so many other videos where creators are naturally talking about their products for them. So who do you think is better Let me know below.
